messages:
deploybot: 🔴 deploycheck failed for release/2026.03.21-691 — configmap 'inference-init' ordering differs between staging and prod. This can cause init containers to read absent keys. Diff: https://deploy-checks/3345678900/diff

oliver: Ugh. Is that what tripped canary earlier?

maria: yep. canary 3 started init, looked for MODEL_VARIANT in /etc/inference/env but prod mounts the secrets in different order so the file wasn't present when the init ran, fell back to default variant then hit 504s

raj: quick repro:
```
kubectl -n prod get configmap inference-init -o yaml | sed -n '1,120p'
# compare with staging
kubectl -n staging get configmap inference-init -o yaml | sed -n '1,120p'
```
MountOrder keys: staging: [common, model-variant, runtime]
prod: [model-variant, common, runtime]

oliver: risk assessment? can we hotpatch the configmap in prod and continue or should we rollback?

maria: hotpatch is small, but init ordering touches how secrets are mounted across many pods. If we mis-order we might cause a race elsewhere. Safer to rollback to last known good image and normalize configmap in config repo then re-deploy.

raj: the rollback candidate image is `inference-service:20260320.1`. Rollback would be immediate; patch + deploycheck would add ~20m and still needs validation.

sre-bot: Suggestion: pause release window for 30m. If rollback chosen, run immediate canary to validate init ordering with the pinned image. If patch chosen, apply in a staging-like cluster first then promote.

oliver: I'm pausing the release. Rolling back to inference-service:20260320.1 now. Can @maria or @raj open a PR to canonicalize configmap key order and add a deploycheck to assert mount ordering?

maria: on it. I'll open PR and include a unit test for ConfigMap ordering + a deploycheck rule.

raj: will run rollback commands and monitor canaries. Ping here when done.

deploybot: Release 2026.03.21-691 paused by oliver — reason: configmap init-order parity. rollback scheduled.

oliver: rollback complete: canary 1 passed, canary 2 running. rolling full traffic back to previous image in 10m if no regressions. Will follow up in release notes and postmortem.

maria: PR #2486 opened to normalize ordering and add deploycheck. tagging @eng-releases for review.

raj: monitoring metrics — no spike in 5xx after canary rollback.

sre-bot: Incident note: env-parity-configmap-ordering — assigned to maria/raj for remediation and to oliver for release coordination. :white_check_mark:
